name: fragile_density
doc: bug-fix density at/above which a file is flagged defect-prone (drives the Reliability scorecard dimension)

name: consensus_band
doc: criticality spread that flags a multi-vote judgment 'contested'

name: content_cap
doc: max chars of file content stored on a Barkpark paper

name: collinearity_cut
doc: |r| above which two signals are collinear (the weaker is dropped)

name: hotspot_percentile
doc: percentile cut for the hotspot refactor line (churn × complexity)

name: priority_percentile
doc: percentile cut for the priority worklist

name: js_scan_roots
doc: directories scanned to build the JS/TS workspace dependency graph (rung ② — a bound LIST)

name: bug_fix_words
doc: commit-subject terms that mark a bug-fix (drives defect-density → Reliability). A bound LIST tunable through a paper.
